notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 callback enable and disable services. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies callback suppression and release for both callback models, interaction delivery identity and tags, standard double-enable and double-disable errors, declaration cleanup, resignation, disconnect, and normal federation destruction without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery and standard federation cleanup
